name: Family Reunification / Family Formation

qualifying_event.description: A spouse, partner (family formation), child, or parent of a Curacao resident or Dutch citizen may apply for a residence permit with family.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage/partnership certificate or proof of relationship; proof of sponsor's income; proof of suitable housing.

requirements.blocker_text: Where the sponsor is a Dutch citizen married to a foreigner, minimum household income of ANG 1,500/month is required, plus ANG 250/month per child under 5, ANG 350/month per child up to 11, and ANG 500/month per child 12+.
requirements.fix_path: Increase and document household income to at least ANG 1,500/month (plus per-child amounts).

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must have sustainable, suitable housing effectively available.
The foreigner applying for admission, and their family members, must not pose a threat to public order.

requirement_groups.name: Sponsor is a foreigner (marriage between two foreigners)

requirements.blocker_text: Where the marriage is between two foreigners, minimum household income of ANG 3,000/month is required, plus the same per-child amounts as the Dutch-sponsor group.
requirements.fix_path: Increase and document household income to at least ANG 3,000/month (plus per-child amounts).

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must have sustainable, suitable housing effectively available.
The foreigner applying for admission, and their family members, must not pose a threat to public order.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/partnership certificate or proof of family formation relationship
Declaration of no objection (for minor children only)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source reviewed

sources.title: Immigratiedienst Curacao -- Family Reunification/Family Formation FAQ: income thresholds by sponsor nationality and per-child amounts, housing requirement, public-order requirement, unrestricted work rights for spouses of Dutch citizens

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Curacao's initial build. work_rights is 'full' specifically because the source states foreigners married to Dutch citizens receive a permit 'without work restrictions, allowing direct labour market participation' -- this was extended here to both requirement groups since the source did not state a different (more restrictive) work-rights rule for the foreigner-sponsor group; that extension is a judgement call, flagged. pr_after_months (120) reuses the general 10-year continuous-residence rule confirmed in cw_permanent_residence.json's source, since family-based residence permits are ordinary residence permits for that purpose -- not independently re-confirmed as applying to this specific category. No minimum marriage/partnership duration before the family permit can be granted was stated in the source (unlike several other countries in this dataset that specify e.g. a minimum years-of-marriage figure) -- not invented here. The two requirement_groups intentionally omit their own outcome_override since the FAQ did not distinguish the two sponsor groups on outcome, only on income threshold.
